scope: Targeted primary literature and official documentation review, not a systematic review. Brief original synthesis; no article copies. Source code provenance is recorded in the odin-contract topic. Live documentation may change.

sources.title: Hegglin et al. — Overview and update of the SPARC Data Initiative: comparison of stratospheric composition measurements from satellite limb sounders
sources.scope: Community profile/climatology diagnostics and multi-instrument comparison; its cited sampling-bias study did not include SMR.

sources.title: Rodgers and Connor — Intercomparison of remote sounding instruments
sources.scope: Observation operators, averaging kernels and comparison of profiles/derived quantities; requires compatible state representations.

sources.title: von Clarmann et al. — Overview: Estimating and reporting uncertainties in remotely sensed atmospheric composition and temperature
sources.scope: Uncertainty terminology, retrieval characterization, correlations and error components; not Odin release validation.

sources.title: Toohey and von Clarmann — Climatologies from satellite measurements: the impact of orbital sampling on the standard error of the mean
sources.scope: Conditions and limitations of standard-error estimates for orbital sampling.

sources.title: Toohey et al. — Characterizing sampling biases in the trace gas climatologies of the SPARC Data Initiative
sources.scope: Model-based estimation of sampling effects; numerical bias results are not Odin uncertainty estimates.

sources.title: Grieco et al. — Improvement of Odin/SMR water vapour and temperature measurements and validation of the obtained data sets
sources.scope: FM13/FM19 profiles, sensitivity and comparison; screening/collocation choices are product-specific.
sources.locator: Section 2.1 and figure 2; section 4 and figures 7–11

sources.title: Grieco et al. — Recovery and validation of Odin/SMR long-term measurements of mesospheric carbon monoxide
sources.scope: CO recovery and validation precedent; CO is not CO2.

sources.title: Updated global and regional trends of stratospheric ozone profiles
sources.scope: LOTUS GLS/proxy framework for long ozone records; its pre-1997 regime is not observed by Odin.

sources.title: Bognar et al. — Stratospheric ozone trends for 1984–2021 in the SAGE II–OSIRIS–SAGE III/ISS composite dataset
sources.scope: Trend uncertainty and treatment of temporal correlation/gaps; another dataset, not Odin validation.

sources.title: Rösevall et al. — A study of ozone depletion in the 2004/2005 Arctic winter based on data from Odin/SMR and Aura/MLS
sources.scope: Tracer relationships, vortex descent and passive-ozone approaches; historical processing versions.

sources.title: Urban et al. — Odin/SMR limb observations of stratospheric trace gases: Validation of N2O
sources.scope: Historical N2O morphology and transport evidence; not current v3 accuracy.

sources.title: Pérot et al. — Unusually strong nitric oxide descent in the Arctic middle atmosphere in early 2013 as observed by Odin/SMR
sources.scope: NO time–height and warming-relative diagnostics with external context; historical processing.

sources.title: Taylor et al. — Evaluating the consistency between OCO-2 and OCO-3 XCO2 estimates derived from the NASA ACOS version 10 retrieval algorithm
sources.scope: Contrast with SMR: pressure-weighted dry-air columns, prior and kernel corrections. Does not establish Odin CO2 or CH4 products.

sources.title: Crameri, Shephard and Heron — The misuse of colour in science communication
sources.scope: Perceptually appropriate, accessible scientific colour maps. Publisher full-text fetch redirected; title/summary and figure-6 guide verified through indexed publisher content.
sources.locator: Figure 6 guide and indexed publisher summary

sources.title: Pérot et al. — Odin/SMR L2 data: format and overview, version 1.1
sources.scope: Monthly-netCDF and historical API fields/filtering; not a universal current Parquet schema or kernel-basis guarantee.

sources.title: Murtagh et al. — Odin/SMR Product Validation and Evolution Report, version 1.3.0
sources.scope: Product/mode/epoch caveats and supported domains; does not validate every subsequently published file.

sources.title: Odin-SMR — Analyze Odin-SMR Parquet data
sources.scope: Release selection, anonymous HTTPS and bounded preview semantics. HTTP 200 text/markdown verified 2026-11-15 via direct request after web reader failed.
sources.locator: Select and retain the exact inputs; Quick preview with Python or SQL

sources.title: Odin-SMR — Physical schema: historical frequency-mode-1 example files
sources.scope: Units and row semantics for two checksummed example files only. HTTP 200 text/markdown verified 2026-11-15 via direct request.

sources.title: NASA JPL — Aura MLS Data
sources.scope: Explains sign-censoring bias for valid noisy retrievals. MLS flags and vertical ranges are not Odin screening rules.
